blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—TNT, behind the hot shooting of RR Pogoy and the all-around play of import Nick Hornsby, secured a quarterfinals berth in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup after repeating over San Miguel Beer, 116-98, on Saturday at Ynares Center here. Pogoy fired 21 points on five three-pointers while Hornsby put up 23 points, six rebounds, four assists and three steals as the Tropang 5G won for the second straight time since the resumption and became the third team to qualify for the playoffs.
